title: Nvidia's CEO Quit, Then Came Back 11 Days Later
hook: Nvidia's CEO resigned on the spot, and 11 days later he was back.

claims.claim: On November 12, 2026 Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member of Nvidia, effective immediately.
CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO.
The board said Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
On November 23, 2026 the Nvidia board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang, 11 days after his resignation.
Nvidia stock jumped about 31% on November 23 after the reinstatement.
On November 24 and 25 the stock fell (5.86% and about 8% after the open) amid a broad AI/tech selloff.
CNBC reported, citing people familiar with the board's thinking, that the decision was sealed by a personal promise from President Trump that Huang had not broken national security laws.
An investigation by a committee of independent directors is continuing.
